description: SDG  6.4.1 Change in Water-Use Efficiency Over Time by Sector is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. SDG indicator 6.4.1: change in water-use efficiency over time in Qatar by sector (agriculture, industry, municipal/services): water used, value added, water use efficiency and its rate of change, 2016-2021. n\a = not applicable (base year). Methodology updated per FAO AQUASTAT definitions. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are water use efficiency. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
